lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 24-30 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in 6 discernible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like spatial pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high luminance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, moderate-luminance pixel clusters primarily located along the anterior margin and the superior tip of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
